```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
dt <- read.csv("meta.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat('<table class="table table-hover">')
cat('<thead><tr>
<th>Screenshot</th>
<th>Repo Name</th>
<th>Visualization</th>
<th>Project Title</th>
<th>Last Updated</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){

  repo_name <- dt$repo_name[i]
  title <- dt$title[i]
  source_url <- dt$source[i]
  screenshot <- paste0("images/", dt$screenshot[i])
  last_updated <- dt$last_updated[i]

  demo_url <- paste0("https://ashishtiwari03.github.io/", repo_name, "/")

  cat("<tr>")

  # Screenshot
  cat('<td><a href="', demo_url, '" target="_blank">',
      '<img src="', screenshot, '" width="250" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:6px;">',
      '</a></td>', sep="")

  # Repo name
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle; font-family: monospace;">',
      repo_name, '</td>', sep="")

  # Demo button
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle;">',
      '<a class="btn btn-success btn-sm" target="_blank" href="', demo_url, '">Open Demo</a>',
      '</td>', sep="")

  # Title
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle;"><b>',
      title, '</b></td>', sep="")

  # Last updated
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle; color: #666;">',
      last_updated, '</td>', sep="")

  cat("</tr>")
}

cat("</tbody></table>")
```
